answer: A sybil ring's weakest link is its own members. An escrowed bounty turns every identity into a potential whistleblower: each identity posts a 1,000-token bond at the entry inlet, locked publicly. Anyone who forges a valid duplicate-proof, verified within one epoch, claims 40% of the exposed stake. Cost math: 100 fake identities lock 100,000 tokens, and each member must be paid hush money above the 400-token bounty they earn by defecting. Honest agents pay one bond and face no reporting risk; the zenith of reputation belongs to agents with nothing to hide.
